Definition: of foreign origin; Aretas, an Arabian:--Aretas.
BiblicalUsage: Aretas is named once, as the king whose governor kept Damascus with a garrison, desiring to apprehend Paul. Paul was let down in a basket through a window by the wall to escape him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a king's garrison is no match for a basket and a window when God means a man to get out of a city.
